scripts.fonts:update: mkdir -p public && curl -fsSL 'https://fonts.google.com/metadata/fonts' | node -e "const fs=require('fs');let d='';process.stdin.on('data',c=>d+=c);process.stdin.on('end',()=>{const j=JSON.parse(d);const list=j.familyMetadataList.map(f=>({family:f.family,category:f.category||'',popularity:f.popularity??9999}));fs.writeFileSync('public/google-fonts.json',JSON.stringify(list));console.log('Updated',list.length,'Google Fonts');});"
